payload.title: Babulus sign-in through Prospectus accounts
payload.description: Replace the email-only Amplify Authenticator (apps/studio-web/amplify/auth/resource.ts, components/authenticator.tsx, lib/use-auth.ts) with Google sign-in per the chosen model. Add server routes for sign-in, callback and account selection, copied from Cyclotron Lab (src/decision_flywheel/account_routes.py, docs/central-accounts.md) or Papyrus (app/api/auth/prospectus/*, lib/prospectus-session.ts). Use @anthus/prospectus-accounts-client /server (SigV4 from the Babulus runtime role) and keep tokens server-side. Depends on the Prospectus registration task.
